parameters.query: SELECT job_id, job_type, status, provider, period_from, period_to, dry_run, progress_total, progress_completed, warning_count, error_count, last_error, heartbeat_at, created_at, started_at, finished_at FROM trading.import_jobs WHERE job_type = 'news' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30;
SELECT ijl.job_id, ijl.status, count(*) AS anzahl FROM trading.import_job_items ijl JOIN trading.import_jobs j ON j.job_id = ijl.job_id WHERE j.job_type = 'news' GROUP BY ijl.job_id, ijl.status;

SELECT import_job_id, count(*) AS anzahl, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ticker_match_status = 'matched') AS matched, count(*) FILTER (WHERE ticker_match_status = 'ambiguous') AS ambiguous, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_general_market) AS general_market FROM trading.historical_news WHERE import_job_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY import_job_id;
SELECT * FROM trading.import_jobs WHERE job_type = 'news' AND status IN ('queued','running','pausing') ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1;
=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = 'paused' WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND status = 'pausing';
=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()) WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND status = 'queued';

SELECT config_key, value_numeric, value_text FROM trading.pipeline_config WHERE config_key IN ('GDELT_PROBE_WINDOW_MINUTES', 'GDELT_MARKS_PER_WORKER_RUN', 'GDELT_EARLIEST_DATE', 'GDELT_REQUEST_DELAY_MS', 'IMPORT_MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS');

=SELECT * FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $json.job_id }}' AND (status = 'pending' OR (status = 'running' AND heartbeat_at < now() - interval '15 minutes')) ORDER BY sequence_number LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: =UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET status = CASE WHEN error_count > 0 THEN 'completed_with_warnings' ELSE 'completed' END, finished_at = now() WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Tick-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Tick-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status IN ('pending','running')) AND status NOT IN ('completed','completed_with_warnings','cancelled');
=UPDATE trading.import_job_items SET status = 'running', started_at = COALESCE(started_at, now()), attempt = attempt + 1, heartbeat_at = now() WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
SELECT ticker, name, aliases_json, exclude_patterns_json FROM trading.stock_instruments WHERE aktiv = TRUE;

=UPDATE trading.import_jobs SET progress_completed = (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Tick-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status = 'completed'), error_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM trading.import_job_items WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Tick-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}' AND status = 'failed'), heartbeat_at = now() WHERE job_id = '{{ $('Baue Tick-Kontext').all()[0].json.job_id }}';
